players.product: Optical transceivers (5G wireless, FTTH 10G EPON, tunable, 100G coherent) with in-house laser chips; 800G/1.6T data centre transceivers and ELSFP CPO light source in development

quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report: H1 2026 consolidated revenue KRW 37,677,505,788, up about 26% year on year on a broader product portfolio; operating loss improved 85% and net loss improved 92%. Q2 2026 revenue KRW 19,651,552,517, operating loss KRW 870,134,578. Optical modules KRW 33,412 million (88.7%), optical devices KRW 2,759 million (7.3%) on a separate basis.
Half-year report: H1 2026 utilisation 36.7% for optical modules (174,697 units produced vs 476,520 capacity) and 22.7% for optical devices (245 wafers vs 1,080).
Half-year report: order backlog KRW 42,136 million at 06-30-2026 (optical modules KRW 40,073 million, optical devices KRW 2,063 million); orders total KRW 79,605 million.

Half-year report: the company is developing an ELSFP (External Laser Small Form-factor Pluggable) used as the external light source for CPO, and is in business cooperation with a large overseas customer on ELSFP.

Half-year report: developing and promoting 200G, 400G, 800G and 1.6T data centre transceivers and a 100G PAM4 EML laser to enter the data centre market; R&D on 100mW-class high-power CW lasers and 100GBaud-class EML chips for 800G/1.6T modules; a 70mW high-power laser for silicon photonics has been developed.

Company outlook (half-year report): revenue growth expected in 2026 from networks beyond 5G wireless (FTTH, CATV/MSO, telecom, data centre); 10G full C-band tunable transceivers shipping on new orders from a US network equipment maker since early 2025; 120km 100G QSFP28 coherent transceiver shipping since 2025; 200G/400G coherent qualification under way; high-power 10G EPON OLT transceiver in mass production with in-house laser diodes.

Half-year report customer concentration: four unnamed customers each over 10% of consolidated revenue in H1 2026 - KRW 5,107,493 thousand, KRW 5,966,369 thousand, KRW 9,414,861 thousand and KRW 3,943,841 thousand; Asia revenue KRW 18,865,381 thousand.

OE Solutions.why: Korean optical transceiver and laser-chip maker developing 800G/1.6T data centre transceivers and an ELSFP external light source for CPO; benefits from the optical interconnect build-out.
OE Solutions.evidence: OE Solutions Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026): developing ELSFP for CPO in cooperation with a large overseas customer; 200G-1.6T data centre transceivers and 100G PAM4 EML in development.
